name: Samsung Galaxy A08 LTE
gaming_notes: The Helio G99 runs popular titles like PUBG Mobile and Free Fire smoothly at balanced settings on the 90Hz display.

name: Tecno Pova Curve 2 5G
gaming_notes: The Dimensity 7100 with Ice Cooling 3.0, a 144Hz curved AMOLED (2160Hz instant touch sampling) and bypass charging make this a strong mid-range gaming pick — TECNO claims 90 minutes of stable Free Fire at 60fps. The 8,000mAh battery stretches long sessions, though 45W charging needs ~82 minutes for a full refill.

name: Motorola Moto g37 5G
gaming_notes: The Dimensity 6300 runs PUBG Mobile smoothly on medium settings; the 120Hz LCD keeps casual games fluid. Don't expect high-refresh competitive gaming at this price.

name: Realme Note 80
gaming_notes: The entry-level Unisoc T7250 with 4GB RAM is built for light gaming and everyday apps; only simple titles run smoothly on the 90Hz HD+ display.

name: Vivo V80 Lite 5G
gaming_notes: The Dimensity 7300e is a strong midrange gaming chip that runs demanding games at medium-high settings; the huge battery means marathon sessions.

name: Poco C95 Pro
gaming_notes: The Helio G91 Ultra runs casual and mid-tier games smoothly; demanding titles need low-medium settings. No 5G on this 4G-only model.

name: Motorola Signature 27
gaming_notes: The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 is the most powerful chip yet — any game will run effortlessly on it.

name: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE
gaming_notes: The Exynos 2500 handles demanding games at high settings with ease; the 6.7-inch 120Hz AMOLED and 4,900mAh battery make long gaming sessions comfortable, though it trails true flagships in sustained peak performance.

name: Tecno Spark 50 Pro
gaming_notes: The Helio G100 Ultimate + 8GB RAM is good for medium gaming. PUBG will run smoothly on medium-high settings.

name: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max
gaming_notes: The A20 Pro is a true flagship chip — PUBG/BGMI runs at max settings without breaking a sweat, and the 120Hz OLED display keeps everything buttery smooth.

name: Apple iPhone 18 Pro
gaming_notes: With the A20 Pro under the hood, this is among the fastest gaming phones you can buy — every title runs at its highest settings, and 12GB RAM means zero reloads.

name: Apple iPhone Duo
gaming_notes: The A20 Pro is flagship silicon, so every game runs at its best — but the foldable form factor and price make this a luxury device first, a gaming phone second.
